watches.description: SERKET ORBITAL Celestial Turquoise PVD Automatic Inspired by the quiet brilliance of the night sky, the Serket Orbital Celestial Turquoise in black PVD steel distills celestial beauty into a refined everyday timepiece. Free of unnecessary distractions, the design emphasizes proportion, balance, and craftsmanship, allowing every detail to speak for itself. Housed in a perfectly balanced 37mm case, the Orbital offers a contemporary interpretation of classic dress watch proportions. The brushed and polished 316L stainless steel case flows seamlessly into a matching steel bracelet, while a supple black leather strap is included for a more formal presentation. Whether worn on steel or leather, the Orbital transitions effortlessly from everyday wear to special occasions. Protected by a domed sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating and pressure tested to 100 meters (10 ATM) of water resistance, the Orbital combines enduring performance with understated elegance. The Serket Orbital Celestial Turquoise is designed for those who appreciate timeless proportions, mechanical craftsmanship, and the quiet confidence of exceptional design. watches.name: PROVOCATEUR Obsidian
watches.description: The Serket Provocateur Obsidian is a study in restrained power — an elegant mechanical dress watch designed with a dark, seductive presence and refined modern proportions. Its vertically brushed black dial shifts subtly beneath the light, creating depth and texture while polished applied numerals and sculpted hands deliver sharp contrast with effortless sophistication. Encased in polished stainless steel, the 41mm silhouette is balanced by a refined 48mm lug-to-lug profile, allowing the Provocateur to wear with both authority and elegance. The slim profile and flowing case architecture create a timeless form inspired by classic horology while remaining unmistakably modern in execution. At its core beats the Sellita SW260 Swiss Made Movement, featuring 31 jewels and a 38-hour power reserve — delivering dependable performance with the soul and character only a true mechanical timepiece can provide. The small seconds display adds a touch of traditional watchmaking heritage, reinforcing the Provocateur’s refined dress-watch identity. Paired with a tapered 22mm to 18mm genuine leather strap and a 22mm FKM rubber strap, the Provocateur Obsidian is designed to transition effortlessly from formal tailoring to late-night sophistication. Provocateur Obsidian is elegance with an edge — a dress watch engineered not to whisper, but to linger. watches.name: TACHYMETRE Teal
watches.description: The Serket Tachymetre is a meca-quartz powered chronograph watch with cutting edge style. This racing themed chronograph watch will exude a real presence on your wrist. A tachymeter is a specialized watch feature that relies on a scale inscribed around the outside rim of a watch, either as part of the rotating bezel or fixed on the watch case. A tachymeter can be used to calculate speed based on travel time or to measure distance relative to speed. One of the biggest benefits of using a tachymeter is that its functionality is independent of any unit of distance, so long as you stick to the same unit of length for your calculations. In simpler terms, a tachymeter can be used for calculating miles, kilometers, meters, or other units per hour. It can also measure the frequency of a regularly occurring event in occurrences per hour. Essentially, a tachymeter is a tool that allows the watch wearer to convert elapsed time (seconds per unit) to speed/rate (units per hour). Produced in limited quantities with only the best components, the Serket Tachymetre is available in various colorways making it a must for all watch and race enthusiasts. All watches have an engraved serial number on the caseback. The Reef 2.0 was our most successful model ever released so we have reimagined it. Water-resistant to 300 meters, the REEF 2.0 sports diver looks incredible in and out of the ocean or pool. Produced in limited quantities with only the best components, the Serket REEF 2.0 automatic dive watch with swiss movement is available in Stainless Steel or Black PVD Stainless Steel. Every REEF 2.0 Watch comes with a Steel Bracelet, Leather Strap, and a Fluorocarbon Rubber Strap. Many versatile looks with the 2.0! watches.name: WRAITH PVD/White
watches.description: The Serket Wraith PVD automatic watch has arrived. In development for 5 years, we invite you to add this uniquely designed modern timepiece to your collection. With a unique Hex Star Six-Sided Bezel, 200 Meters of Water Resistance, a Screwdown Crown, and its Signature "Bolt" Embossed Caseback, the Wraith isn't afraid to get you in over your head. Rugged, Reliable, and Resistant to corrosion in the pool or seawater. This Onyx Black & White Colorway is limited to just 25 pieces. All Wraiths have an engraved serial number on the caseback. WATCH SPECIFICATIONS CASE Black PVD Stainless Steel 316L Brushed/Polished Width from 10 to 4: 46mm Width from 10 to 4 including crown: 50.5mm Lug to Lug: 54.5mm Lug Width: 24mm Total Height: 14mm BEZEL Fixed Hex Star (Six Sided) 40.4mm 6 Screws Counter Set CRYSTAL Flat Sapphire Anti-Reflective Coating Diameter: 37.5mm MOVEMENT Miyota Automatic caliber 9015. The Miyota caliber 9015 is a 24 Jewel Automatic M ovement. The accuracy of the caliber 9015 is within -10~30 seconds per day. Equipped with a ball-bearing rotor, this power plant works very precisely with 28,800 half oscillations per hour. Reserve is 42 hours. CASEBACK Screwdown Crown at 3:00 Diameter: 6mm Height: 4mm CROWN Crown at 3:00 with Crown Guards Diameter: 7mm Height: 4.5mm STRAP 24mm Fluorocarbon Rubber Quick Release Strap in Black Polished Stainless Steel Engraved Buckle WATER-RESISTANT 200 Meters (20ATM) Pressure Tested DIAL AND HANDS 2 Layer Matte Sandwich Dial-in Black Onyx & White Stainless Steel Hands Luminous Hands and Numbers 3, 6, 9, & 12. WEIGHT 158 Grams WATCH POUCH/INSTRUCTION & WARRANTY BOOKLET Black Leather Custom Travel Pouch and Instruction & Warranty Booklet REFERENCE SWC2021WPVDOW0001
